title: Bike-Bench-Working
summary: A benchmark suite for generative models on bicycle design data, with notebooks that fit and sample synthetic bike designs for embedding and evaluation experiments. SDV's single-table module (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, and TVAE synthesizers) is imported and run as benchmark generative models against bike design datasets.
